source_refs.note: Exercise 13.3, Question 7 (a)-(c): rate of change and maximum of S(x) = 400x - x^3 (book p.258). Answer key (PDF 311) prints it as number 13.

blocks.prompt: 7 (a) The stress on a beam under a varying load is given by \(S(x) = 400x - x^3\), where \(S(x)\) is the stress in pascals (Pa) and \(x\) is the distance from the fixed end in meters. Calculate the rate of change of stress at 6 meters.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh rate of change ka sawal hai.
Humein \(S'(6)\) find karna hai.
Yeh beam ke andar ka stress hai: engineer jaanna chahta hai ke fixed end se door jaate hue stress kitni tezi se badalta hai.
Plan: \(S(x)\) ko differentiate kar ke \(x = 6\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S(x) = 400x - x^3\) (pascals aur meters).
Humein find karna hai: \(S'(6)\).
Tareeqa: Stress ka rate of change \(= S'(x)\), bilkul Example 16 ki tarah. Yeh batata hai ke fixed end se ek meter aage jaane par stress taqreeban kitna badalta hai.

\(x = 6\) rakhein
\[S'(6) = 400 - 108 = 292\]
Kyun: \(6^2 = 36\), \(3 \times 36 = 108\). Unit Pa/m (pascal fi meter).

blocks.prompt: 7 (b) The stress on a beam under a varying load is given by \(S(x) = 400x - x^3\), where \(S(x)\) is the stress in pascals (Pa) and \(x\) is the distance from the fixed end in meters. Find the distance where the stress is maximized.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh maximum ka sawal hai.
Humein woh faasla \(x\) chahiye jahan stress sab se zyada ho.
Plan: \(S'(x) = 0\), positive root lena (faasla negative nahi hota), phir sign check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S'(x) = 400 - 3x^2\), \(x \ge 0\).
Humein find karna hai: maximum stress ka faasla.
Tareeqa: Maximum par \(S'(x) = 0\).

\(S'(x) = 0\) hal karein
\[3x^2 = 400\]
\[x^2 = \dfrac{400}{3}\]
\[x = \dfrac{20}{\sqrt{3}} \approx 11.55\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{400} = 20\) aur \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\), \(20 / 1.732 \approx 11.55\). Negative root \(-11.55\) chhor diya, kyunke fixed end se faasla negative nahi ho sakta.
Dhyan dein: Square root lete waqt dono roots aate hain; phir sawal ke mutabiq sahi root chunein.

Maximum ki tasdeeq
\[x < 11.55:\ S'(x) > 0\]
\[x > 11.55:\ S'(x) < 0\]
Kyun: Misaal: \(S'(6) = 292 > 0\) aur \(S'(12) = 400 - 432 = -32 < 0\). Pehle stress barhta hai, phir ghatta hai, to 11.55 m par maximum hai.

Maximum stress (izafi)
\[S\left(\dfrac{20}{\sqrt{3}}\right) = \dfrac{16000}{3\sqrt{3}} \approx 3079.2\ \text{Pa}\]
Kyun: \(400x - x^3 = x(400 - x^2)\), aur \(400 - \frac{400}{3} = \frac{800}{3}\). Sawal ne sirf faasla poocha hai, lekin yeh value samajh ke liye achhi hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (c) The stress on a beam under a varying load is given by \(S(x) = 400x - x^3\), where \(S(x)\) is the stress in pascals (Pa) and \(x\) is the distance from the fixed end in meters. Is the stress increasing or decreasing at \(x = 6\) meters?
blocks.explanation:
Barhna ya ghatna derivative ke sign se pata chalta hai.
Humein \(S'(6)\) ka sign dekhna hai.
Plan: part (a) ka jawab istemal karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(S'(6) = 292\) (part (a) se).
Humein find karna hai: \(x = 6\) par stress barh raha hai ya ghat raha hai.
Tareeqa: \(S' > 0\) ka matlab barh raha hai (increasing), \(S' < 0\) ka matlab ghat raha hai (decreasing).

Sign dekhein
\[S'(6) = 292 > 0\]
Kyun: Positive slope ka matlab hai graph upar ja raha hai jaise \(x\) barhta hai. Part (b) se bhi yahi milta hai: 6 m maximum point 11.55 m se pehle hai, aur maximum se pehle stress barh raha hota hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(x = 6\) m par stress barh raha hai (increasing), kyunke \(S'(6) = 292 > 0\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 13 par chhapa hai: (a) 292 Pa/m, (b) \(x = 11.55\) m, (c) increasing, sab sahi.
